async def save(x):
    return x


async def ok(x):
    return True


async def load(x):
    return [x]


# CASE await_in_filter expect=fire
async def c1(items):
    return [x for x in items if await ok(x)]


# CASE await_in_second_iterable expect=fire
async def c2(items):
    return [y for x in items for y in await load(x)]


# CASE nested_comprehension expect=fire
async def c3(groups):
    return [[await save(y) for y in g] for g in groups]


# CASE async_comprehension_stream expect=pass
async def c4(stream):
    return [x async for x in stream]


# CASE async_comprehension_await_body expect=fire
async def c5(stream):
    return [await save(x) async for x in stream]


# CASE two_gen_three_filters expect=fire
async def c6(a, b):
    return [await save(x + y) for x in a for y in b if x if y if x != y]


# CASE set_comprehension expect=fire
async def c7(items):
    return {await save(x) for x in items}


# CASE conditional_element expect=fire
async def c8(items):
    return [await save(x) if x else None for x in items]


# CASE walrus_filter expect=fire
async def c9(items):
    return [y for x in items if (y := await save(x))]


# CASE dict_two_filters expect=fire
async def c10(items):
    return {x: await save(x) for x in items if x if x > 1}


# CASE three_filters expect=fire
async def c11(items):
    return [await save(x) for x in items if x if x > 1 if x > 2]


# CASE four_filters expect=fire
async def c12(items):
    return [await save(x) for x in items if x if x > 1 if x > 2 if x > 3]


# CASE five_filters expect=fire
async def c13(items):
    return [await save(x) for x in items if x if x > 1 if x > 2 if x > 3 if x > 4]


# CASE generator_expression_await expect=fire
async def c14(items):
    return sum([await save(x) for x in items])


# CASE three_generators expect=fire
async def c15(a, b, c):
    return [await save(x) for x in a for y in b for z in c]


# CASE three_generators_filter_each expect=fire
async def c16(a, b, c):
    return [await save(x) for x in a if x for y in b if y for z in c if z]


# CASE gen_filter_then_second_await_iter expect=fire
async def c17(a):
    return [y for x in a if x for y in await load(x) if y]
